# Expected output SHAPE for s01 (the minimum agent loop).
#
# LLM output is non-deterministic, so this is the SHAPE to look for, not a
# byte-exact transcript. With `-v`, a successful "write a file" run looks like:
#
#   [s01] provider=anthropic model=claude-sonnet-4-6 url=
#   [turn 0] assistant: I'll create that file for you.
#   [turn 0] -> write_file map[content:hi path:hello.txt]
#   [turn 0] <- wrote 2 bytes to hello.txt
#   [turn 1] assistant: Done. I created hello.txt with the text "hi".
#   Done. I created hello.txt with the text "hi".
#
# What to verify you ran it correctly:
#   1. At least one "[turn N] -> <tool> ..." line  (the model asked for a tool)
#   2. A matching "[turn N] <- ..."                (the tool ran, result fed back)
#   3. A later turn with NO tool call              (stop_reason=end_turn)
#   4. The final assistant text printed to stdout  (the loop's return value)
#
# If you see "loop exceeded MaxTurns=...", the model kept calling tools without
# finishing — raise -max-turns or give a clearer prompt.
